_about: ZTZ-99A laser dazzler (Osama 16 Nov 2026): native APS that stops guided interceptable missiles up to reachMeters away; unguided rounds (RPG, recoilless) pass. Read by runtime-qa/Dazzler.cs. 16 Nov 03:2x (Osama "much brighter and more obvious ... make the beam a lot thicker"): core 0.12 -> 0.35 m, glow 0.45 -> 1.4 m, 0.35 -> 0.6 s, colours x3 (HDR, above 1 = brighter than white). 03:4x (Osama "let's set the interception range to 200m"): reachMeters 100 -> 200. 03:4x (Osama "replace the 762 gun on the ZTZ ... use the same laser as the aps"): laserWeapons [2009081] = beam on each LSDW pulse. 03:47 (Osama "just make it do minimal damage thats fine"): no zero-damage hook (laserAmmo unset); the pulse does 0.2 damage. 03:5x (Osama): LSDW is a +100 protection option on ZTZ-99A and ZTZ-99 (laser APS 999 charges / 60 s + LSDW laser weapon); laserWeaponNames ["LSDW"]; the unit card shows cardIcon instead of the APS icon, without a count. 04:2x (Osama "this laser should fire and be animated in pulses every time it fires"): beam.laserSeconds 0.2 = each LSDW pulse shows for 0.2 s.
